subject: Gen7 causal diagnostics: current-main identity loss + Core V1 integration deltas
body: Completed bounded causal-diagnostics/attempt-identity lane at current main 633c75be. SOURCE finding: current structured Transition Lab cannot causally join an opening end-to-end. TransitionEvent lacks immutable opening/presentation attemptId and normalized visualProgress; recordIngressStage omits generation; Gen3 opening knows local movementId+generation but recordStage drops both from typed rows; vsync and SurfaceControl transaction rows contain timing/hinge observations but no attempt/host/presentation/refresh identity. Primary Gen7 Core V1 materially fixes ownership with immutable serviceEpoch+attemptId and threads it through hinge/receipt/migration/refresh primitives, but Android wiring should preserve these review deltas before field build: per-frame currentGeneration and callback/expected-present timestamps; explicit semantic provenance/coarse-shadow telemetry; append-only monotonic distinct FIRST_PRESENTED/FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE receipts; no silent active-attempt replacement through begin(); timestamped refresh acquire/observe/release. The proposed observation-only causal ledger validator PASSes deterministic adversarial cases plus 100,000 randomized valid sequences. Peer adaptive-profile lane independently corroborated that frame/transaction rows must be exact-attempt-bound before latency priors are learned. No control-law changes and no production writes. Recommended disposition: READY_FOR_MANAGER_REVIEW; wire typed attempt identity into Gen7 telemetry before the next field-diagnostic build.
